description: Mapping rules to generate RETConfigWDTInternal.xlsx from CDD.xlsx (4G CDD sheet) using the RETDeviceNamingRuleSouth template.

source._note: Columns are located by HEADER NAME (case/whitespace tolerant), not by position, so the CDD may have extra/reordered columns (e.g. an added Latitude column).

cell_id_map.note: Local Cell ID (New): tens digit -> band (X), units digit -> sector (Y). Authoritative (band, sector) key; falls back to CellName chars (cell[-2], cell[-1]) when absent or unrecognized.

tx_rx_mode.note: L1800-only sector: 4T4R keeps device _2 as L1800; 2T2R makes it L1800_NOT_USED, tilt 0 (Case 6 in RET-Tool-logic.xlsx). Currently parsed and stored per sector; the device-count redesign will consume it. Output is unchanged for now.

columns.rru_name: RCU所在扇区名称 / RRU Name(*)
columns.rcu_tilt: 电调天线角度 / RCU Tilt(*) unit=0.1度

Y.meaning: last char of CellName -> sector identifier

three_g.logical_sector_header: Logical Sector Name (RRU SiteName"-"Logical sector ID)
three_g.match_note: Site match key = 3G 'Site' column == 4G 'SiteName (RRU Location)_Old'. The sector number is taken from the Logical Sector Name (text after the last separator), NOT from its prefix.
three_g.rule: Device No 3 (band E) is resolved against the 3G Installation Design sheet. Build the lookup key as {SiteName_Old}{separator}{sector number}. If that Logical Sector Name exists, emit NSN_U2100 (e.g. AGGPQC01_686001_NSN_U2100_S1_1) with RCU Tilt = round(New E-Tilt * 10) taken from that sheet (first non-blank value per sector); otherwise emit NOT_USED keeping the same sector and _1 suffix (e.g. AGGPQC01_686001_NOT_USED_S1_1) with tilt 0. Color/SRN of the device-3 slot are unchanged.

text_config.description: Rules for the RET_template.txt -> RET_output.txt text conversion (ADD RET / MOD RETTILT MML script). DEVICENAME prefix, SERIALNO and TILT are rewritten from RET_input.txt + the CDD-derived rows.

input._note: RET_input.txt: line 1 = site name (== CDD SiteName_New); remaining lines are whitespace/tab separated columns. Indices are 0-based after splitting on whitespace.

template._note: MML field names and the two line kinds. prefix_token_count = number of leading underscore-separated tokens in DEVICENAME that form the site prefix (site + Ne ID), which get replaced; the rest (band_sector_slot) is kept.

rules.devicename: Replace the leading {prefix_token_count} tokens of DEVICENAME with {SiteName_New}_{Ne ID (New)} (the CDD 'Site Name'); keep the band/sector/slot suffix from the template.
rules.serialno: Replace SERIALNO with the input serial whose (CTRLSRN, RIGHT(serial,serial_suffix_len)) matches the template line's (CTRLSRN, RIGHT(SERIALNO,serial_suffix_len)).
rules.tilt: MOD RETTILT TILT = the RCU Tilt of the ADD RET device with the same DEVICENO, matched POSITIONALLY: CTRLSRN -> sector_id, plus the device's order within that sector (1st..4th) -> the corresponding CDD row's RCU Tilt.

rcu_tilt.note: CDD E_TILT is in degrees; WDT requires 0.1° units, so multiply by 10.

device_name.note: Device Name == RRU Name per template.

column_copy_rules.rule: value in column H = value in column B
column_copy_rules.note: Output Device Name (H) mirrors output RRU Name (B).

row_expansion.note: Each CDD CellName row maps to one WDT row keyed on (X,Y). For each sector that exists in CDD (Y in {A,B,C,...}), a 4th 'NOT_USED' device row should be emitted per sector if not already present, to match the naming rule template (devices 1-4 per sector).
